`FFMPEG_BIN` (default `ffmpeg` on PATH) - decoder to 16kHz mono WAV.
`WHISPER_MODEL` (default `small.en`) - ggml model name; the file is `<WHISPER_MODEL_DIR>/ggml-<model>.bin`.
`WHISPER_MODEL_DIR` (default `/opt/benmore/models`, fallback `./models`) - where the ggml model files live.

`WHISPER_BIN`, `FFMPEG_BIN` and `WHISPER_MODEL_DIR` are host settings (the server's process environment). On the hosted platform they are platform-managed, like `PATH`, `LD_*`, `DYLD_*` and `GIT_*`: `set_env` refuses them and stored values are dropped. `WHISPER_MODEL` and `TRANSCRIBE_*` stay app-settable.
`TRANSCRIBE_TIMEOUT` (default `10m`) - per-call deadline; on timeout the whole subprocess group (ffmpeg/whisper + children) is killed, no orphans.
`TRANSCRIBE_THREADS` (default `2`) - whisper `--threads`. `TRANSCRIBE_NICE` (default `19`) - subprocess niceness so a transcription can't starve the app.
